note.text: Penicillin allergy with a rash, moderately severe, supplied by the owner for the revised UC04 narrative (2026-11-04: the referral carries 'Allergies', none named). Captured by Dr. Webb during the structured virtual assessment as patient-reported history. Relevant downstream: the in-office practice should avoid penicillin-class antibiotics.
